scripts.kink: bun scripts/roms.ts corpus && bun scripts/krs.ts kink
scripts.mooneye: bun scripts/roms.ts mooneye && bun scripts/krs.ts cases krs/oracles/mooneye/sm83.toml --output json --save krs/oracles/mooneye/results/sm83.jsonl
scripts.claims: bun scripts/krs.ts prove --spec-module SM83-CONTRACTS-SPEC --depth 32 --claim-timeout 600 --output jsonl --save krs/sm83/results/claims.jsonl
scripts.compare: bun scripts/roms.ts corpus && cargo build --release --offline --quiet --manifest-path krs/sm83-rust-cpu/Cargo.toml && bun scripts/krs.ts kink compare
